policy: One bespoke written prediction per HIGH-confidence selection. Each is at least 30 words, states the selection explicitly, and is built only from facts that were read on an official source. No two predictions reuse the same sentence structure or the same single argument.

items.text: Back the Milwaukee Brewers on the money line in World Series Game 1. They finished the regular season 103-59 and were 55-26 at American Family Field, the best possible place to open a series. Tampa Bay won 98 games but were only 43-38 on the road, and the Brewers arrive 6-1 in the post-season after sweeping the Dodgers.
facts: Brewers regular season 103-59 (.636), home 55-26 (.679)
Rays regular season 98-64 (.605), road 43-38 (.531)
Brewers post-season 6-1, including a 3-0 sweep of the Dodgers

items.text: Milwaukee Brewers again on the money line in Game 2, this time on workload rather than venue. Milwaukee closed out the Dodgers on 14 October and have had nine days to line up their rotation, while Tampa Bay needed six games and a postponement to get past Cleveland, finishing on 19 October. A 55-26 home record behind a rested staff is the selection.
facts: Brewers last played 2026-10-14 - nine days before Game 2
Rays last played 2026-10-19 after a six-game series that included a postponement
Brewers home record 55-26

items.text: This is a Tampa Bay Rays selection for Game 4. Their 55-26 home mark is the strongest single venue input in this series, and once it replaces the neutral baseline the model makes them a 59% favourite. Milwaukee's 6-1 post-season record was built on four home games out of seven, and their road form in the regular season was 48-33.
facts: Rays home record 55-26 (.679)
Brewers road record 48-33 (.593)

items.text: Tampa Bay Rays again in Game 3 at Tropicana Field. The Rays were 55-26 at home in 2026, the identical home record Milwaukee posted, and they are 7-2 this post-season after a 7-3 win over Cleveland that closed the series. Milwaukee were a solid but unremarkable 48-33 on the road, so the venue flips the edge.
facts: Rays home record 55-26; Brewers road record 48-33
Brewers played four of their seven post-season games at home
